COOPERATIVE DRAINAGE PROJECTS
The Division may participate in cooperative drainage projects only with the advanced approval of the Highway District Engineer. The Division will decline to participate in the cost of any drainage project, or drainage work, on or adjacent to any primary road unless:
1. it is clearly evident that the work will benefit the primary road
2. the project is for the purpose of restoring natural drainage which has been diverted or retarded by the Division's construction or maintenance operations resulting in damages to private property
3. a landowner through or along whose land a public high-way passes and who desires to drain into the highway may so drain if he gives due notice to the Division and receives from the Division written permission for any work, ditching, or excavating he proposes to do within the limits of the highway.
NEEDS FOR PLANNING
It is the responsibility of the Division to plan, design, construct, and maintain all roads in the State highway system, including appurtenant drainage systems, so they are safe for the traveling public. The drainage phase of projects should be reviewed at an early stage with other government agencies, with local officials and with affected property owners, to insure the best design. This review will reveal the requirements for all drainage facilities and other aspects which must be considered in the proper design of the highways.
